issues.title: [INKWAVE][Paint][要検証] アメフラシRainNum=72と公開版172回の塗り呼出の対応を校正する
issues.originalRequirement: Identify the sourced meaning of RainNum and compare generation, reuse, ground contact, paint writes, area, distribution and timing.
issues.testedOrObserved: Existing deterministic public-source and composed accounting separates 172/172/171 calls from 178 candidate rays; it does not map either count to Nintendo particles.
issues.remaining: Find an applicable lifecycle source and compare like quantities; make a gameplay change only if an actual discrepancy is established.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Aim] Controller sensitivity uses 0.2×–3.0× instead of Splatoon 3's −5…+5 right-stick scale
issues.originalRequirement: Calibrate independent right-stick 0/end anchors and intermediate mapping while preserving profiles, gyro and dead zones.
issues.testedOrObserved: Legacy-gain migration and overlapping upper-yaw settings were repaired; the current curve is provisional.
issues.remaining: Establish the requested reference anchors and intermediate mapping; do not present provisional tuning as source-confirmed.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Motion] Verify Splat Dualies 4+1 WU dodge scale, easing and glide calibration
issues.originalRequirement: Verify the Dualies roll 4+1 distance, timing, glide/easing, dive/default rules and independent coordinate mapping.
issues.testedOrObserved: Existing 4+1 movement/timing controls cover the implemented model.
issues.remaining: Obtain or verify the independent anchors and semantics needed to compare the model; no arbitrary replacement.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Perf] Mobile post stack permanently pins two full-resolution RGBA16F composer buffers
issues.originalRequirement: Reduce mobile persistent color allocation in idle and normal battle; preserve output, resize cleanup, desktop HDR and context stability.
issues.testedOrObserved: Guarded packed/HDR resources and cleanup have source, emitted and browser fixture evidence with explicit pixel tolerances.
issues.remaining: Software completion candidate: final required exact-head CI and the documented acceptance scope remain outstanding; do not infer hardware memory or FPS.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Systems] Ink Storm can damage enemies arbitrarily far below the cloud because no vertical cutoff is enforced
issues.originalRequirement: Bound vertical storm damage using a validated rain volume and cutoff, preserving DPS, cover and ownership at 30/60/120 Hz.
issues.testedOrObserved: An internal finite lower boundary and cover/owner tests address the unbounded-damage defect; its cutoff is not a verified S3 measurement.
issues.remaining: Establish the reference volume, lower cutoff and coordinate convention, then validate boundary, cover and owner behavior.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Perf] Frustum-culled actors keep Character pose, foot-IK raycasts and hair simulation running every tick
issues.originalRequirement: Remove simulation-cadence offscreen ground work, materially reduce Character visual CPU, preserve authoritative state and correct first-visible reentry at 30/60/120 Hz.
issues.testedOrObserved: Ground rectangle inference and synchronous Actor-bus memo invalidation were corrected; an earlier native-source fixture still sampled ground on 600/600 budgeted ticks.
issues.remaining: Demonstrate safe reduced ground-query cadence and comparable visual CPU in a camera-away scene, preserving support, muzzle, history and first draw; these correctness fixes increase work and do not complete the performance goal.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Movement] Normal jumps ignore B hold duration so small and high jumps collapse to one arc
issues.originalRequirement: Verify a sourced current-S3 hold cutoff and progression while preserving input buffering, coyote and distinct jump paths.
issues.testedOrObserved: Tap and hold produce distinct trajectories; existing 5F/0.7 tuning is explicitly provisional.
issues.remaining: Validate the original cutoff/curve against relevant source semantics rather than inventing coefficients.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Motion] Heavy Splatling charge entry ignores S3 dedicated ground-deceleration curve-delay
issues.originalRequirement: Implement or validate Splatling charge-entry ground deceleration with source parameters and frame trace, preserving steering and cancellation.
issues.testedOrObserved: The current solver no longer incorrectly cancels existing reversal/orthogonal deceleration.
issues.remaining: Establish the relevant current-S3 delay/curve semantics and validate the requested frame trace.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Physics] Splat Charger muzzle height ignores footwear, removing S3 shoe-dependent shot origin
issues.originalRequirement: Verify footwear-dependent authoritative Charger muzzle height with two sourced distinct soles and cover/guide/shot parity.
issues.testedOrObserved: Available catalog metadata describes abilities/materials but did not establish sole transforms in the bounded audit.
issues.remaining: Find suitable source-model or other independent sole/transform evidence and test two distinct shoes before tuning.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Dualies] Verify native paint phases, droplet dynamics and height/default rules (S3 11.3.0)
issues.originalRequirement: Verify native Dualies phase/feet selection, droplets, height composition and sparse default/world mapping.
issues.testedOrObserved: Existing native paint and turf controls cover current behavior.
issues.remaining: Resolve the specific phase permutation, nearest-foot, droplet and height/default semantics against suitable source evidence.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Motion] Ordinary weak diagonal walking gait does not match Splatoon 3
issues.originalRequirement: Match weak diagonal walk cadence, stride, foot contact and direction/velocity continuity to the current-S3 reference.
issues.testedOrObserved: Current source-bank cadence and existing motion controls are implemented.
issues.remaining: Establish and compare the S3 weak-input selector and progression; preserve the Character QA scope hold.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Motion] Hit reactions use one weapon-agnostic flinch instead of Splatoon 3's weapon-class damage poses
issues.originalRequirement: Verify class-appropriate damage/idle/moving selection, directional timing, attachment and remote/gameplay behavior.
issues.testedOrObserved: The current source-bank generic Damage and native upper-body class layer are distinct; provisional visual behavior has tests.
issues.remaining: Find the relevant S3 class selector/joint timing evidence and validate it without turning provisional curves into source claims.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Motion] Non-shooter jumps reuse generic airborne pose despite Splatoon 3 weapon-class jump animations
issues.originalRequirement: Verify S3 class-specific jump choice when distinct and preserve start/air/land/fire priority and attachments across rates.
issues.testedOrObserved: Existing jump/source-bank and attachment behavior has software tests.
issues.remaining: Establish which S3 clips and selector are actually applicable, then compare timing and ownership.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Weapons] Quad and Explosher projectile birth/origin alignment gap
issues.originalRequirement: Resolve Quad and Explosher first/steady birth-to-visible-muzzle alignment across aim, cadence, OBB, LOS and authority.
issues.testedOrObserved: Source and emitted tests plus retained actual draw evidence cover both owners, including intentional blocked/predicted fallback.
issues.remaining: Software completion candidate: required exact-head CI and recorded fixture/visual limits remain; do not invent a retail aperture condition.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Perf] Complete calibrated whole-game crowd A/B benchmark
issues.originalRequirement: Calibrate a repeatable equivalent whole-game software A/B with matched workload/readback, ABBA/BAAB and frame statistics.
issues.testedOrObserved: A native/native software comparison has failed its strict identity gate; isolated operation-level savings are recorded separately.
issues.remaining: Produce a calibrated matching baseline and complete the requested paired measurements before claiming a speedup.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Plan] 軽量Pose Search・歩行品質・インク視認性の性能非劣化実装計画

issues.title: [INKWAVE][Specials/Investigate] Zipcaster failed-hook retry uses 45F versus 11.3.0 ShotFailedIntervalFrm=20
issues.originalRequirement: Separate failed-hook 20F source field from observed 45F retry phases and verify miss, near-floor, near-wall, input and cost behavior.
issues.testedOrObserved: A separately supported successful-hook 20F minimum was fixed; the current 44/45/46F miss controls retain the 45F behavior.
issues.remaining: Resolve the source meaning of the failed-hook timing phases or document a supported no-change outcome; do not simply replace 45F with 20F.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][P1/Net] Authentic actor owner can forge lethal hit packets without firing or proving collision
issues.originalRequirement: Require trusted weapon action, resource, timeline and geometry evidence before accepting PvP hit damage, including legitimate lag/migration behavior.
issues.testedOrObserved: Malformed births no longer mint executable projectile proof. In the 3054 emitted diagnostic presentation-only attacks cause zero damage, but valid-shaped forged projectile events still cause 36 HP without sender launch or receiver contact.
issues.remaining: Connect production-required trusted action/contact authority with genuine positive, no-fire/forgery, lag and migration controls; component replay alone is not that authority.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][P1/Boss] Authenticated guests can invent valid Boss-hit claims without weapon fire or collision
issues.originalRequirement: Require trusted action/contact and weak-state evidence for Boss/crablet hits, with correct proof consumption, migration and legitimate attack controls.
issues.testedOrObserved: Existing proof ordering and malformed-birth fixes reject several false claims. The 3054 emitted valid-shaped forged projectile diagnostic still inflicts 36 HP on Boss and crablet without actual launch/contact.
issues.remaining: Connect trusted Boss/crablet action and contact authority in the mandatory production path; retain valid weak-state and replay/migration behavior.

issues.title: [INKWAVE][P0/Perf] iPad Safari native Turf falls to 5 FPS / sim 174.9ms at 60% resolution
issues.originalRequirement: Identify the dominant native gameplay CPU path and demonstrate material improvement in a comparable full workload without changing simulation, paint, collision or AI.
issues.testedOrObserved: Controlled 8-actor/7-bot/300-tick traces and selected query reductions retain state; whole-workload timings varied and did not establish material recovery.
issues.remaining: Profile and fix the demonstrated dominant path, then compare equivalent workloads and output; device FPS is waived.

issues.testedOrObserved: Existing audio controls and candidate-source reviews do not establish version, provenance or rights for all named cues.
issues.remaining: Identify and verify the required cue/event sources and usage rights before adopting or publishing assets.

issues.remaining: Complete equivalent multistage/practice profiling and parity-backed repair; device tracing is waived.

issues.remaining: Resolve the slope, speed-limit and default semantics with reliable relevant evidence before changing behavior.
